$comment: Maps each hub plugin id to its public GitHub repo (owner/repo, exact casing). Source of truth for the live version pipeline: scripts/refresh-plugin-versions.mjs reads this, queries each repo's latest tag, and writes data/plugin-versions.json, which render-plugin-pages.py bakes into each page's version chip. Add a plugin here when you add it to plugin-pages.json. Kept separate from plugin-pages.json so the version pipeline never has to rewrite that format-sensitive file.
